_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Arlanda C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).

Still withheld after the research pass: Underground: OSM numbers none of the platforms and Trafikverket's lines don't run alongside an OSM platform outline; needs the platform numbers from Swedavia's or the operator's plan.
